title: Billing Operations Bulletin: Monthly Subscription Fee on Community Solar Subscriptions
content:
## The fee

For each utility billing cycle in which the utility applied a solar credit to the subscriber's utility account, Beacon Ridge invoices one Community Solar Subscriptions subscription fee, the plan's invoice lag in utility billing cycles later. Subscription fees are invoiced only while the subscription is active, cancellation pending or closed; the status is read from the subscription's system record.

The fee equals the bill credit value multiplied by 100 less the discount used, divided by 100, rounded per the plan's rounding convention (to the cent, half a cent rounding up), and is never below the plan's minimum subscription fee per cycle: the fee is the higher of that minimum and the rounded amount. The discount used is the plan's discount percentage. On plans with an annual escalation of the discount above 0.0, the discount used rises by the plan's escalation figure on each allocation anniversary.

Credits the utility carries forward on its own bill do not change the fee, and low project production is not compensated when the plan provides no compensation for production shortfall.

## What each fee line shows

| Item on the line | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Billing period start | First day of the utility cycle whose credit is invoiced |
| Bill credit | Value of the solar credit the utility applied in that cycle |
| Discount applied | The discount used |
| Amount | The fee, a positive amount |
| Posted date | The invoice date |

A subscription fee raises the net amount Beacon Ridge has invoiced the subscriber; savings true-ups, sign-up and referral credits and rebill credits reduce it.

## Status and invoicing

| Subscription status | Subscription fee invoiced |
|---|---|
| Waitlisted | No |
| Active | Yes |
| Cancellation pending | Yes |
| Closed | Yes |
| Withdrawn | No |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Bill credit | Discount used | Credit multiplied by (100 less discount), divided by 100 | Rounded fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| $84.37 | 12.0% | $74.2456 | $74.25 |
| $50.25 | 10.0% | $45.225 | $45.23 (exact half cent rounds up) |

In each row the minimum fee taken as $0.00 does not bind, so the fee is the rounded amount.
